correctness.rationale: For normal real K=aI+bJ, exactly three restarted inner calls give P3(γK)=I−γK+(γK)^2−(γK)^3; because K is rotation-dilation, its squared norm is the scalar |(1−z^4)/(1+z)|². With r=γL,c=a/L, q−1=G/(1+r²+2rc), G=r^8−2r^4(8c^4−8c²+1)−r²−2rc. Both angular boundaries and all r<=1/2 are strictly negative. Any first nonnegative maximum at r<1 is interior and solves G=∂cG=0. Independently verified resultant 65536r^16(4r^6+4r^4+4r²+3)^2 H(r²), H(u)=16u^6−32u^5+48u^4−104u³+72u²−8u+3; Descartes substitution yields exactly one positive root u∈(0,1). Rational sample r=19/20,c=2/3 has q=1773279907/1728000000>1 (independent exact 2×2 matrix multiplication); a neutral scaled rotation occurs at unique r*=sqrt(u*)≈0.940521095740431. The universal result applies only to normal two-dimensional saddle K, not arbitrary nonlinear/non-normal models.
